# Policy claim: medical and health claims

## Forbidden
- "Prevents injuries", "cures plantar fasciitis", "orthopaedic", "corrects pronation", "recommended by physiotherapists".
- Any wording that implies a medical device or a therapeutic effect, in Italian or English, including customer review excerpts selected for the page.

## Allowed
- Comfort and fit statements: "reduces friction", "supports the ankle", "cushioned midsole".
- Material facts: "merino wool regulates temperature".

## Why
EU medical device regulation and consumer law; two complaints in 2025 about "anti-blister" wording on socks. Applies to briefs, product copy, structured data and ads.
